task.title: Website (Remove a team member from program page) — Alpha Bethesda
task.description:
REQUEST
Remove a team member from program page

DETAIL
Remove Chelsea as Dean of Parents

Add Pam Jackson, PhD as Dean of Parents

BIO - Dr. Pam Jackson has spent more than two decades at the intersection of organizational and behavioral economics, helping people and institutions across the Middle East, the UK, Europe, and Capitol Hill unlock their full potential. Her path has taken her from advising organizations and building high-performing teams to a deep, hands-on commitment to education — ten years on the board of directors of a DC public charter school, and another ten years with an educational nonprofit. Every chapter of her career has led to the same conviction: that when people are given the right support, there is no limit to what they can become. She brings that conviction to Alpha Bethesda, where her purpose is singular — to stand as a true partner in every family's success.

Pam states: "I joined Alpha to be a part of the most remarkable innovation in education today, and I want to empower the people who are committed to their children's limitlessness. The world that gets created because young people flourish and thrive everywhere in life is phenomenal."

Add Nicole Noel as Director of Admissions (Chantilly/McLean/Bethesda)

Change tuition $65,000

Change email - admissions.bethesda@alpha.school

Phone # 240-206-1830
